Hi!

I'm Ameet calling from Shiksha Nation.

You had recently enquired about our Live Classes for your child, and I'm calling regarding the same.

At Shiksha Nation, our focus is not just on completing the syllabus—we work on building strong concepts from Day 1 so that students perform better in school exams with confidence.

May I know if I'm speaking with the parent or the student?

 
If Parent
Thank you.

May I know your child's name?

Parent: Maira

Thank you.

Before I explain how Shiksha Nation can help Maira improve her concepts and score better, may I know which class she is currently studying in?

Parent: Class 8

Great.

How much did Maira score in her last annual examination?

Parent: 80%

That's a good score.

May I ask if there is any particular subject where Maira is facing more difficulty and because of that she's unable to score even better?

Parent: Mathematics

I understand.

Many students scoring around 80% have good understanding of most subjects, but a single subject like Mathematics often becomes the biggest hurdle in crossing the 90% mark.

That's exactly where structured concept building, regular practice and continuous monitoring make a significant difference.

Based on Maira's current performance, I believe one of our academic programs would be suitable for her.

 

Since Maira has scored around 80% and is looking to improve further, our Marks Guarantee Program (MGP) could be a good fit. It focuses on small batches, personalised mentoring, regular testing, doubt support and structured academic monitoring to help students consistently improve their performance.

Along with this, all our students receive live interactive classes, experienced full-time faculty, regular tests, weekly performance reports and recorded lectures for revision.

The exact fee depends on three things:

● Maira's previous academic performance,
● the program selected, and
● the scholarship she qualifies for.
That's why, before discussing the final fee, we first help students attempt our UnlockX Scholarship Quiz, through which they can earn up to 40% scholarship on the course fee.

Once the scholarship result is available, one of our Senior Academic Counsellors will personally review Maira's profile, discuss her Mathematics challenges in detail, recommend the most suitable learning plan and explain how Shiksha Nation can help her achieve better marks.

May I share the Scholarship Quiz link on this WhatsApp number?

Parent: Yes.

Perfect.

I'll share the link right away.

It takes only 15 minutes to complete and you'll receive the scholarship result immediately after submission.

May I also schedule a counselling session with our Senior Academic Counsellor for two days from now? By then, your scholarship result will also be available, making the discussion much more meaningful.

Thank you.

You'll receive both the Scholarship Quiz link and the counselling confirmation shortly on WhatsApp.

Have a wonderful day!
